Review complete. Verdict: **approve** (tier2 — holds for human sign-off, not auto-merge).

The diff is a legitimate corrective fix for a real audit-confirmed FAIL on PR #596: interim/RA bills were posting with silent $0 GST (no line ever carried a `taxTemplateId`) and a negative "Retention held" invoice line was further understating the taxable subtotal. The fix now requires and validates a real org-owned `taxTemplateId`, extracts a pure `computeInvoiceTaxTotals()` for independent testing, and correctly moves retention to a separate holdback field rather than a taxable-subtotal-reducing invoice line (GST is due on full certified value regardless of retention terms). Migration (renumbered 0265→0267 to resolve a post-merge collision) matches `schema.ts` exactly and follows the established RLS convention. No `.github/workflows/**` changes. Two items flagged for the human reviewer: the migration hasn't been applied/advisor-checked against a live Supabase project yet, and a pre-existing (not newly introduced) bill-numbering race condition.
